title: Mike Hammer
paragraphs: Radio adventures based on Mickey Spillane's hard-boiled detective Mike Hammer, represented largely by the 1953 series That Hammer Guy and its violent, fast-moving criminal cases.
Mutual radio adaptation of Mickey Spillane Mike Hammer.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Larry Haines era (1953 to 1953) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] and Ted de Corsia era (1954 to 1954) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Larry Haines (performer), Ed Ladd (announcer), Edward Adamson (writer), Mickey Spillane (creator), Richard Lewis (director), Ted de Corsia (performer), and Jan Miner (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]].
The stories often return to hard-boiled private-eye noir, murder investigation, violent criminal underworld, Mutual network detective radio, and collector title and transfer variants.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes That Hammer Guy on Mutual and Fragmentary Mike Hammer radio survival and collector aliases.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|cbs-radio-workshop|CBS Radio Workshop]], [[show|cloak-and-dagger|Cloak and Dagger]], [[show|the-chase|The Chase]], [[show|the-mysterious-traveler|The Mysterious Traveler]], and [[show|theater-five|Theater Five]].
